approach: Matching decompilation with GCC 2.8.1, splat and maspsx, byte-identical main executable and 7 stage overlays
help: Moving the remaining data out of asm/
notes: All 1,088 game functions are matched C: the main executable SLUS_011.93 and the 7 stage overlays (STAG0000 to STAG4000.PRO) rebuild byte for byte, checked against the SHA-1 of each retail file. Functions, globals and struct fields are named where the code proves them, and doc/STATE_MAP.md maps every global. The build is shiftable, so the C can be changed and relinked. The PsyQ libraries are Sony's code, not the game's, and stay as split asm outside the progress.
